name: Harpeth River Woodworks
old_description: We create each of our high quality projects with passion and craftsmanship, tailored to elevate your space.
about:
Harpeth River Woodworks operates from Nolensville, Tennessee, with a fabrication shop in nearby Chapel Hill. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it presents itself as a woodworking studio dedicated to heirloom-quality furniture and cabinetry.

The shop produces custom cabinetry for kitchens, baths, and built-ins, as well as one-of-a-kind furniture pieces shipped nationwide. It also offers CNC machining services including custom signs, engraving, CNC doors, and custom part machining. A design phase using 3D renderings precedes production, and flat-pack packages are available for DIY enthusiasts and contractors. The facility blends traditional hand tools with modern CNC equipment, though specific machine models and headcount are not published.

Customers range from homeowners seeking lasting pieces to contractors and businesses needing custom millwork. The company notes that its furniture graces homes across the country and that it serves both residential and commercial projects.

Harpeth River Woodworks emphasizes that its work is built to outlast the trees it comes from, using real wood, traditional joinery, and durable finishes. The collaborative process—listen, design, create—is described as the core differentiator, with the goal of delivering pieces that can be passed down for generations.
